proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Everything follows formally from the commutative double restriction diagram with both squares cartesian written in the statement of the double-restrict lemma. Forward direction: the image of h'' is contained in the image of h because g'' = g composed with g', so the lower right corner U of the diagram may be replaced by h(U' x_U R), making conditions (1) and (2) the statement that the diagram lives over a tau-covering of that image; the cartesian squares then exhibit h'' as a base change composition through h', and base change preservation of P gives h'' has P. Converse direction: h' equals the composition of pr_0 : U' x_{g,U,t} R to U' with the pullback structure; pr_0 is a tau-covering as a base change of the tau-covering t : R to U of condition (a), so tau-locality on the target descends the property P from h'' to h'. (source lines 1104-1114)

standard_prerequisites.name: The double restriction diagram: h, h', h'' with a commutative diagram whose both squares are cartesian (more-groupoids chapter, Lemma lemma-double-restrict, canonical tag 04MW; same-chapter item, triaged out of this lane's pool for its own proof but statement-level diagram fully written)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the commutative and cartesian squares from which both directions follow formally.

core_obligations: Forward direction (1)(2)(3) imply h'' has P: the image of h'' is contained in the image of h since g'' = g composed with g', so U in the lower right corner of the double-restrict diagram may be replaced by h(U' x_U R); conditions (1) and (2) say this replacement happens over an open target covered by the tau-covering {h}; by the cartesian squares of the diagram the morphism h'' is, over that image, the composite of h' with a base change of a morphism having P, and since P is preserved under base change, h'' has P. Converse direction (a)(d) imply h' has P: the projection pr_0 : U' x_{g,U,t} R to U' is a tau-covering, being the base change of the tau-covering t : R to U along g; the cartesian squares express h' composed with the covering as the pullback of h'', and tau-locality on the target descends P along the covering, so h' has P.
proof_roadmap: Reduce both directions to the commutative cartesian double restriction diagram of lemma-double-restrict (proof lines 1105-1106).
Forward: replace U by the open image h(U' x_U R) using image containment and conditions (1)(2), then transfer P along the cartesian squares by base change preservation (proof lines 1107-1111).
Converse: note pr_0 is a tau-covering as the base change of the covering t of condition (a), and descend P to h' by tau-locality on the target (proof lines 1111-1113).
